user.title: Calendar Reminders
user.description: Pick the calendars to watch. A reminder is sent only for events whose description ends with a #remind line, e.g. "#remind 1h @anna". Add the receiving phones and tablets afterwards as devices on the integration page.

data_description.calendars: Local and Google calendars both work. Changes in local calendars are picked up at once, others within 15 minutes.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Calendar Reminders is already set up. Change it with Configure, or add devices on the integration page.

data_description.default_devices: Get the reminder when a #remind line names no @device.
data_description.fallback_device: Also gets the reminder when a #remind line names an unknown @device (a typo), with a note saying which.
data_description.snooze_short: Minutes for the first snooze button.
data_description.snooze_long: Minutes for the second snooze button.
data_description.all_day_time: When "#remind 1d" (or 2d, 1w, ...) on an all-day event fires, on that day. "#remind 1d@07:30" sets its own time.

user.title: Add device
user.description: A phone or tablet with the Home Assistant Companion app.

data_description.alias: Short name used in the #remind line, e.g. anna for "@anna". Lowercase letters, digits and _ only.
data_description.notify_action: The device's notify action, e.g. mobile_app_annas_phone.
data_description.language: Language of the reminder texts and buttons on this device.

reconfigure.title: Edit device
reconfigure.description: Changing the alias doesn't update existing #remind lines.
